episode_summary: Guest curator Bertie Torillians joins Dan, James and Anna for an episode ranging from Thai language quirks and names to the reality of soft‑shell crabs and crab biology, Victorian rectal devices and human bum evolution, and the Icelandic Punk Museum plus other quirky museums. It’s a lively mix of linguistics, marine life, medical oddities, and offbeat cultural institutions.
